record.question: A patient in the radiology department is complaining of severe, crushing chest pain. The radiographer's immediate action should be to:
options: Instruct the patient to walk slowly to the emergency room.
Assume it's indigestion and continue the procedure.
Call for immediate medical assistance and place the patient in a comfortable position.
record.explanation: Answer D: Call for immediate medical assistance and place the patient in a comfortable position.. Severe crushing chest pain is an emergency: summon immediate medical help and keep the patient comfortable while awaiting it. Reference: https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle; https://aerb.gov.in/images/PDF/DiagnosticRadiology/REGULATORY-REQUIREMENTS-FOR-DIAGNOSTIC-RADIOLOGY-PRACTICE.pdf; https://nucleus.iaea.org/sites/nss-oui/Published%20Chunks/m_60b8e698-4f59-4c24-809a-dfb819ac5050/c_92a88144-44da-418c-a878-9c778590e687__9_0.Html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
